```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = rprojroot::find_rstudio_root_file()) #set working directory to rproject root
```

# Load packages
```{r, message=FALSE}
library('data.table') #for loading large files (i.e. GO annotations)
library("VennDiagram") #for plotting venn diagrams
library("tidyverse") #for data manipulation
```

# Load data

Will load the following data

- GO annotations produced using Trinotate for this study
- GO annotations produced in previous study using Blast2GO:

KASUGA, T., HAYDEN, K.J., EYRE, C.A., CROUCHER, P.J.P., SCHECHTER, S., WRIGHT, J.W., and GARBELOTTO, M. (2021). ‘Innate Resistance and Phosphite Treatment Affect Both the Pathogen's and Host's Transcriptomes in the Tanoak-Phytophthora ramorum Pathosystem,’ Journal of Fungi, 7(3), pp. doi:10.3390/jof7030198.

```{r}
#load trinotate data
trinotate_GO_df <- fread(file = "GO_analysis/R_topGO/trinotate_GO_terms.tsv", sep = "\t", sep2 = ",", header = FALSE)

#load data from previous study
kasuga_2021_GO_df <- fread(file = "GO_analysis/R_topGO/Kasuga_2021_TableS2_GOs.csv", sep = ",", sep2 = ";", header = FALSE, na.strings = "NULL")

kasuga_2021_GO_df <- na.omit(kasuga_2021_GO_df) #remove NAs as not all genes annotated with GO terms
```

# Check number of annotated transcripts

```{r}
print(paste("Trinotate annotated", nrow(trinotate_GO_df), "transcripts"))
print(paste("Blast2GO annotated", nrow(kasuga_2021_GO_df), "transcripts"))
```

# Check overlap between annotated transcripts for both methods

```{r, message=FALSE}
#set up pdf to save graphs
venns <- "GO_analysis/R_topGO/kasuga_2021_v_trinotate_venns.pdf"
pdf(file = venns, width = 10, height = 10)

vennPlot <- venn.diagram(
  list(trinotate_GO_df$V1, kasuga_2021_GO_df$V1), filename = NULL, 
  fill=c("#9498F8", "#F19B98"), print.mode = c("raw", "percent"), alpha=c(0.5,0.5), cex=1.5,
  category.names = c(" "," "), main = "Shared GO annotated transcripts", main.cex = 2, ext.text = TRUE, 
  ext.percent = 0.1, ext.pos = 0, ext.length = 0.7, ext.dist = -0.01, disable.logging = TRUE)

grid.newpage()

grid.draw(vennPlot)

#kasuga = "#F19B98"
#trinotate = "#9498F8"
```
